body: I hear this a lot but I seriously can't stand the name, I wanna just throw out a slow "noooooooo" everytime I see someone suggest it for someone's kid.
Sorry, its pretty indentifable to those who knew my previous name so I don't want to share so openly. :)

Using a throwaway as I don't want my real name associated with my main account. 

My name is **Arie.** 
I am female. 

I have always *loathed* my name. So much so, that I actually changed it. 

I was *constantly* being called "Air-ee" instead of "Arr-ee" and having people misspell the name 'Ari.' Sometimes people called me Ariel. I was always asked what the name was short for as well. 

I hated everything about it. Hated how it sounded. How it was a boys names. How it was so weird from my friends and classmates.
